# InteractionProcessSwarm

A run's place in a tree of sub-interactions. Present on a run whose interaction lets its participants start them, and on every run started in the tree. The tree's counts are kept on its root.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `rootId` | `uuid` | The interaction run at the top of the tree. A tree started by an interaction that an app started is rooted at that interaction, not the app, so this can differ from `rootProcessId`. |
| `depth` | `integer` | 0 at the root; one more at each level below it. |
| `limits` | [`InteractionSwarmLimits`](interaction-swarm-limits.md) | The tree's limits, settled when its root started. |
| `started` | `integer` | On the root only: how many sub-interactions have been started in the tree so far. 0 on other runs. |
| `running` | `integer` | On the root only: how many sub-interactions in the tree are still going. 0 on other runs. |
| `children` | [`InteractionSubInteraction`](interaction-sub-interaction.md)`[]` | The sub-interactions this run started. |
| `released` | `boolean` | True once this run has ended and no longer counts towards the tree's `running`. |
| `await` | [`InteractionSwarmAwait`](interaction-swarm-await.md)`\| null` | What this run is waiting on, while it is `AwaitingChildren`. Null otherwise. |

    ],

    "takenBy": {
      "id": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
